title: KPVG: Knowledge-prompted vision-genomics model for cancer survival prediction in whole slide images
details: J Shi, C Li, Y Zheng, H Fu - Information Fusion, 2025
abstract: Multimodal cancer survival prediction is a critical clinical task aimed at forecasting the remaining survival time of a cancer patient. It relies on the integration of gigapixel whole slide images (WSI) and tens of thousands of genomic data. The main …
